Nina (People Ops): Quick Q for the travel one-pager: what are the rules for per-diem vs meal receipts, and do we allow spouse meals when on a work trip?
Carlos (Sales): For client dinners, I assume receipts required. But for regular travel, can we use a per-diem?
Sam (Finance): Correct. Two options for meals while overnight: submit actual receipts OR elect daily per-diem. Domestic per-diem (meals only) = $70/day. International per-diem = country-specific (attach country code to claim).
Evelyn (Eng): If I pick per-diem can I still submit receipts for some meals that day?
Sam (Finance): No. Choose one: per-diem covers all meals that day. If you want to claim a client dinner, use "Client Entertainment" category and attach receipts94those are separate and not covered by per-diem.
Carlos (Sales): Spouse/guest policy?
Sam (Finance): We do not reimburse spouse/guest travel or meals unless pre-approved for a business reason (hosting a partner/client). Pre-approval requires manager + Finance sign-off and notes in booking tool. Only the business portion is reimbursable.
Nina (People Ops): Receipts threshold? Small coffee receipts clog the system.
Sam (Finance): Require receipts for any single expense >= $25. Under $25: enter as "misc" with short note; no receipt needed. If a merchant doesn't provide a receipt, use the missing-receipt affidavit for amounts > $50 and get manager sign-off.
ExpenseBot: Reminder: expenses must be submitted within 60 days of travel end date or they may be denied. Link: https://redwood.example/internal/travel
Evelyn (Eng): Hotel cap?
Sam (Finance): Suggested caps: $225/night general, $325/night high-cost cities (NYC/SF/LON). Any exceedance needs pre-approval in TravelPerk.
Nina (People Ops): I'll update the quick guide with a one-line checklist and post it. Any other edge cases?
Carlos (Sales): Conference fees - are VIP dinners covered?
Sam (Finance): Registration + required conference meals = reimbursable with receipt. Optional social events not covered unless pre-approved.
Nina (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll publish by EOD and ping this channel when done. :memo:
